# Open items

Everything this repo has written down as unfinished, in one place, indexed from
[`issues.json`](issues.json). Nothing here is authored: every title below is read out of the
document that owns the item, and the link goes there. Change an item where it lives, then run
`make issues-doc`.

The four registers, and why they stayed separate until now:

| register | holds |
| --- | --- |
| [`PLAN.md` §Open follow-ups](PLAN.md#open-follow-ups) | the roadmap of record; compound narratives, each keeping its own history |
| [`performance.md`](performance.md) | performance and optimization, scheduled by evidence rather than by loop |
| the design docs' §Open questions, and what would answer each | what a document knows it has not settled |
| [`validation/ledger.json`](validation/ledger.json) | the checks a machine cannot run |

Each is internally disciplined; none could see the others. `pnpm gate:issues` now reads all four
and fails when one of them has an item this index does not, which is the direction that matters —
a defect nobody points at is invisible no matter how many pointers resolve.

**The words.** `confirmed` — reproduced, with numbers in its source. `suspected` — read from the
code, never reproduced. `open` — undecided, nothing blocking. `blocked` — the next step is named
and unavailable. `answered` — decided, nothing owed in code. `fixed` — closed in code *and* in a
test that would fail if it came back; the gate refuses the word without one.
